name: murad-ios-studio
description: Agentic pipeline that takes an iOS app from a one-line idea to the App Store: research, PRD, design, architecture, code, review/QA, TestFlight, submission.

interface.longDescription: A studio of specialist skills (researcher, PM, designer, icon designer, architect, developer, reviewer, QA, release manager) that drives an iOS app from idea to submission. Two checkpoints: scope-lock and ship. Verified builds, tests, and screenshots at every step. On Codex, each role and pipeline stage is a skill ($app-researcher, $app-init, etc.) run in the main thread rather than a dedicated subagent.
defaultPrompt: Use $app-run to build a habit tracker for new parents
Use $app-init to scope a recipe-sharing iOS app
Use $app-status to check the studio board
